steps.en: Install it, or run it once with npx
steps.zh: 安装，或者用 npx 直接跑一次

steps.en: Start it in your project and choose Sign in with Google
steps.zh: 在项目目录里启动，选择用 Google 账号登录

steps.en: Ask for what you want in plain language
steps.zh: 用大白话说出你要什么

steps.en: Reads files, searches Google and fetches pages to gather context
steps.zh: 读文件、用 Google 搜索、抓网页，把上下文凑齐

steps.en: Proposes edits and shell commands, pausing for your approval on each
steps.zh: 提出改动和 shell 命令，每一步停下来等你批准

steps.en: Applies what you approved and reports what changed
steps.zh: 执行你批准的部分，并汇报改了什么

value.en: A working terminal agent on a free personal Google account, with no API key or billing setup
value.zh: 用免费的个人 Google 账号就能用上终端 agent，不用配 API key，也不用绑卡

sources: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli#-authentication-options (run gemini, choose Sign in with Google, free tier)
https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli#-key-features (built-in Google Search grounding, file operations, shell, web fetch)
https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/main/docs/reference/configuration.md (approval mode 'default' prompts for approval on each tool call)
